operations.summary: Replace the private shared unsent draft with an idempotent last-accepted update ordered by a client-provided hybrid logical clock; client_sequence increases per session/client and current mutation_id retries reuse the original request

mcp_tool.name: loomhelm.update_draft
mcp_tool.description: Update the caller's private shared unsent draft with a client-provided modification_order. The UTF-8 content is at most 1 MiB; client_sequence is positive and strictly increasing per session/client, stale sequences are rejected, and mutation_id is an idempotency key that must not be reused with different metadata or content. A matching retry for the current projection returns it without reapplying; a retry for an older revision is rejected as stale. Updates are durable and never submit a run.

response_headers.Content-Range: 206 responses use bytes start-end/total; 416 responses use bytes */total.
response_headers.WWW-Authenticate: 401 responses include the Bearer authentication challenge.

operations.summary: Download the authorized original artifact bytes. Range supports satisfiable byte ranges, including multiple ranges; If-Range selects a range only when its strong ETag or HTTP-date validator matches; malformed or unsatisfiable byte ranges return 416 with Content-Range, while unknown range units are ignored.

response_headers.Content-Length: HEAD responses advertise the complete original byte length and never include a response body.
response_headers.WWW-Authenticate: 401 responses include the Bearer authentication challenge.

operations.summary: Read the authorized original artifact download metadata without transferring a response body. HEAD ignores Range and returns the complete representation metadata.

Download a cursor-addressed chunk of the authorized original artifact bytes. Start at offset 0; when offset is non-zero, content_version from the previous response is required; stop at complete=true and verify the reassembled bytes against artifact.sha256.

mcp_tool.name: loomhelm.download_artifact
mcp_tool.description: Download bounded chunks of an authorized original artifact. Start at offset 0, pass content_version with each next_offset call, stop only at complete=true, and verify the reassembled bytes against artifact.sha256.
